_readme: Upcoming brand briefs the scheduler pre-builds soft rosters against.
Operator-maintained: add a block when a brief lands, remove it when the campaign closes.
'category' is what Category Readiness is judged against and therefore what drives
campaign role — it is the field that actually changes the roster, so keep it exact.
Rows marked status 'example' are ILLUSTRATIVE BRIEFS, not real pipeline. They exist so
the scheduler loop can be demonstrated end to end. The brands are fictional. Delete them
before running this against a real book of business.

campaigns.product_description: An AI tool that builds a working app from a plain-English description. Craftly for Students positions it as the tool for university students who want to build without knowing how to code.
campaigns.target_audience: US university students aged 18-24, or creators whose audience skews 18-24 and US-dominant.
campaigns.notes: The campaign this repo was built for. Sourced set lives in data/creators.json.

campaigns.product_description: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. A newsletter analytics tool for solo operators.
campaigns.target_audience: Solo creators and operators running paid newsletters.
campaigns.notes: Fictional. Exercises the LinkedIn path, which is uncalibrated and should return NEEDS_CALIBRATION rather than a score.

campaigns.product_description: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. A note-taking tablet aimed at students.
